title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Barniz de Pasto. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Barniz de Pasto
options.lineage: Pasto's mopa-mopa lacquer craft (UNESCO intangible heritage)
options.thesis: Hand-stretched films of resin, knife-cut and laid layer on layer over carved wood; the dither is how a 1-bit film shows translucency.
options.viewport: The whole viewport is a carved plate: ASCII wood grain, the name laid as knife-cut emerald film, the portrait in a dithered resin window, MAGI as the one gold-leaf piece, CV as a cut tab.
options.risk: International recruiters won't know the craft; if layering is timid it reads as a folk-craft theme rather than a systems engineer's site.

raised.raise: Every dimension snaps to the ASCII character cell, so the wood grain and the layout share one grid.
Rank is inversion: MAGI alone is laid in gold leaf; every other piece is the same emerald film.
Colour is earned: emerald appears only where the work is; all chrome stays carved wood and ink.
One label schema (name · year · stack · status) rules every project, role and degree card.
The cursor is a lamp: near it the dither opens and the wood shows through the resin.

options.label: Negros y Blancos
options.lineage: Pasto's Carnaval de Negros y Blancos (UNESCO): Jan 5 black cosmetic, Jan 6 white talc, then the papier-mâché floats
options.thesis: Dither is literally black and white powder: dark mode is Día de Negros, light mode is Día de Blancos, and the one colour is the float.
options.viewport: A dithered talc burst fills the screen around the cursor, the name huge in difference blend, a yellow carroza shape holds the portrait, the theme toggle labelled with the carnival day.
options.risk: Black/white plus one accent sits close to the generic dev-portfolio monochrome; it only lands if the powder is fully committed. Also the direction most runs would pick.

options.label: Endurance Livery Garage
options.thesis: The portfolio as a race car's livery: a stripe spine for navigation, a number roundel per project, experience on the pit board.
options.viewport: Powder-blue body, marigold stripe across, name in heavy grotesk, roundel 01 for MAGI, CV on the pit board.
options.case: Holds audience identification (your love of cars, instantly personal) but loses clarity: it says 'car fan', not 'systems engineer'.
options.risk: Your pinned 'one main colour' fights the two-tone livery, and ASCII/dither becomes secondary to stripes.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.thesis: CV as a boarding pass, projects reranking on a gate board.
options.viewport: A pass for Camilo Parra beside a live board of projects.
options.case: Scannable but impersonal; nothing in it is Camilo's.
options.kept: One colour reserved for what matters.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Sections step past one fixed window like a cloth blind.
options.viewport: One window, the name stepping in course by course.
options.case: A monitoring world; it buries the work behind the mechanism.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Every heading flips in character by character.
options.viewport: A departure board listing projects as trains.
options.case: Already a dev-portfolio cliché, and the content isn't live data.
options.kept: Everything sits on a fixed character cell.

options.label: Sneaker Box Stacks
options.thesis: Projects as boxes pulled from a stacked wall.
options.viewport: A wall of end labels, MAGI pulled halfway out.
options.case: Fun, but nothing to do with Camilo or the work.
options.kept: One label schema rules every card.

options.label: Luminescent Understory
options.thesis: Content glows awake as the cursor approaches.
options.viewport: A dark forest floor where the name blooms under the pointer.
options.case: The neon-on-black rut, and ungrounded in Camilo's world.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The minimal dev portfolio (chanhdai.com lineage) executed impeccably: ASCII header, hairline column, one accent.
canonCard.viewport: A centred hairline column: ASCII banner, round dithered avatar, name, one-line role, CV button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from hundreds of dev portfolios by design.
